resources.string: Checks every app as soon as it is installed or updated, and warns you if it is harmful. Shows a small permanent notification while on.
Notifications are off, so BlackShield cannot warn you about a harmful app.
Checks new APK files in Download as they arrive, before you install them.
BlackShield cannot see the Download folder yet. Allow \"All files access\" to check downloaded APK files.
New APK files in these folders are checked too. Folders you pick here need no extra permission.

Android only lets an app see files downloaded by other apps with \"All files access\". BlackShield uses it only to check new APK files in Download for malware before you install them. It does not read, upload or change your other files. On the next screen, turn on access for BlackShield.
Automatic updates wait for Wi-Fi or another unmetered network. Sync now always uses any network.
